==Usage==
<pre>
<nowiki>{{MA|url|text (optional)}}</nowiki>
</pre>
Where "url" is the name of the article on Memory Alpha (the part of the URL right after /wiki/), and "text" is what you wish to be the link text (this is to remove unnecessary things such as "(actor)" which may be a part of the article's name).
